notes.title: Phantom Rose 2.0 Update - Scarlet
notes.content:
Hello, this is makaroll, the dev and artist of Phantom Rose. Today I’d like to present the version 2.0 update that I’ve been working on called “Scarlet”, which brings new game mode, content, and changes to the PC version. I hope you like it. If you’d like to talk about the game feel free to join the official discord server :D

[h2]NEW[/h2]
[h3]Scarlet game mode[/h3]

[previewyoutube=saBZARlGAr8;full][/previewyoutube]
With the 2.0 update, existing game mode will be called “Classic” and a new game mode called “Scarlet” will become the new standard way to play. Progress is tracked separately, and players will be able to swap between the two via settings. Think of it as a free expansion DLC.

[h2]About Scarlet[/h2]
[h3]Brand New Gameplay[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/565a8935a764b2bb36913eb8f01bd056ab3e39d5.jpg[/img]

Scarlet’s new gameplay is based on cooldowns. There’s no card loss and there’s no luck-based card draw during battle. All cards you gain through your adventure are accessible during battle and you must defeat your foe by managing the cooldown of each card. If you’re an existing player of the game, please go through the initial tutorial as the gameplay is significantly different!

[h3]New Cards, new skins[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/6f08187465b52594b54e6278bd6cf6395e488c29.jpg[/img]

There are over 100+ cards in Scarlet, with new buffs and debuffs to try. Cards that you’re familiar with in Classic Phantom Rose likely has a fresh new update that I hope you enjoy. There are also new skin types called banner and weapon skins that you can unlock by playing the game

[h3]New Challenges[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/8ee1fb8373111c09f9363cb82c33aaea4946c7e5.jpg[/img]

Scarlet’s adventure has new trial options and challenges. Familiar modes like Risky and Crown Trial is also updated with new content and challenges in addition to a Custom Game mode that you can build and try challenge of your own. 

[h3]Q&A[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/6045f47adfeaddd361380eb7e7a7d5572c6459f2.jpg[/img]

[b]How do I switch between classic and scarlet?[/b]
- There’s a button in settings menu where you can switch between two modes

[b]Is there a restriction in switching between two modes?[/b]
- You can swap between modes at any time

[b]Is my existing progress in Classic transferrable to Scarlet?[/b]
- No, progress is tracked separately and save file cannot be shared

[b]Are Diamonds in Scarlet a currency I can buy?[/b]
- No, Diamonds cannot be bought. They can only be earned by playing the game

[b]Is progress sharable between PC version and mobile version of Scarlet?[/b]
- Unfortunately, progress between different platforms cannot be shared as there’s no global account system

[b]Are there any story differences between Classic and Scarlet?[/b]
- There are no story differences but Scarlet has more story content that I hope you enjoy 


Thank you for reading, I hope you try the new update! And if you’re a new player, I hope you give the game chance. 

Thanks!

notes.title: Winter Update 1.6.0!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/3d66bd431079134f289b8d568f2bf7fb9fd17b4d.png[/img]

Hello! 1.6.0 Winter update is another major update with several changes and new content additions. I hope you like it. If you’d like to talk about the game feel free to join the [b][url=https://discord.gg/phantomrose]official discord server [/url][/b]:)

[h1]New[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/2c0b57ec9ff13cd1cee910799dd32473cc0e8406.png[/img]

[b]Scarlet Ruby & Shrines[/b]
At Rose level 4, "Scarlet Ruby" and "Shrines" will be unlocked for all players when playing adventure mode. The count of ruby will increase along with player’s rose level and these jewels can be used in a new type of an explore area called “shrines”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/b9e5391801707f0a0ac58a808e20cf43a16377db.png[/img]

Shrines are randomly generated areas like camps where players can heal and manage their deck but can also “bless” their cards with special abilities. These abilities, aka "blessings", depend on the type of shrine players find.[list]
[*] [b]Blessing of Blade[/b]: Attack by the value of the card's level after activation
[*] [b]Blessing of Protection[/b]: Gain Barrier with the value of the card's level before activation
[*] [b]Blessing of Life[/b]: Recover HP by the value of the card's level after activation
[/list]

I hope with the addition of ruby and shrines players can attempt and reach higher level of challenges as they play and achieve higher rose level. Please try them out :D


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/d6630479e62936e97a9d0759d3d2459735bc4c2d.png[/img]

[b]New skins & New Trial Option[/b]
3 new skins have been added: Noel, Magical, and Starlight. Along with new skins, three new challenges have been added to unlock the skins. Furthermore, a new trial option called “Shuffle Phantoms” have been added and will be required for one of the new challenges. New challenges are as follows:[list]
[*] [b]Tactician[/b]: Clear an adventure stage with Shuffle Phantoms Trial Option
[*] [b]Shock and Fear[/b]: Clear adventure by defeating all Crown Phantoms using DEBUFF status as the killing blow
[*] [b]Trial Champion[/b]: Clear adventure twice with 5 trial options
[/list]


[b]UI Updates[/b][list]
[*] Player Status modal will now show the list of Crown Phantoms defeated and also the final blow player dealt to them. 
[*] Players can now easily check their trial options without opening the player status.
[*] List of Recommended Challenges will appear once player clears an adventure
[/list]


[b]Other changes[/b][list]
[*] Bonus XP for each trial option has been raised to 250XP
[*] Lili’s DEF reduced by 1
[*] Duke’s ATK reduced by 1
[*] Vampire Doll’s opening pattern changed
[*] Rose Token value reduced to 4
[*] Bunny Charm’s value reduced to 5
[*] Black Axe will now heal player by 2 if item is not skipped
[/list]

Thank you very much for reading and playing. I really hope you enjoy these changes and I wish everyone a wonderful end of year.

notes.title: card patch 1.5.2 + hot fix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/d38dc87129f046fa77c0ed9b4088219fca86a078.png[/img]

Hi! 1.5.2 patch is another follow up to the Halloween update to give some power ups to less popular cards in game. I hope you like it :)

[h1]Card Changes[/h1][list]
[*] [b]Sharpened:[/b] Added extra ability - If an attack does not inflict Bleed, gain Bloodlust status
[*] [b]Incision:[/b] Added extra ability - If target is not bleeding, copy card to deck
[*] [b]Bless:[/b] Ability changed to - Give own debuffs to opponent. Return cards in hand to deck
[*] [b]Hardened:[/b] Added extra ability - Activate Heal when barrier is gained.
[*] [b]Cleanse:[/b] Added extra ability - Destroy opponent barrier
[*] [b]Defense Up:[/b] Ability changed to - Raise DEF by the number of opponent attack cards on field
[*] [b]Illusion:[/b] Duration of Fear status given to attacker increased to 3
[*] Fever Pierce, Attack Up’s levels have been lowered
[*] Sharpened and Vampiric Brace traded levels
[*] Rage and Hardened traded levels
[/list]


[h1]Other Changes[/h1][list]
[*] Rose Token value increased to 5
[*] Trial option’s phantom stat boost have been readjusted to 10%, 20%, 30%
[*] Several phantom’s patterns have been slightly adjusted due to card changes
[*] Rare bug where first block of mystery event will sometimes crash the game fixed
[/list]

[b]1.5.2.1 Hot Fix[/b][list]
[*] Bug of not being able to deselect unavailable trial options fixed
[*] Rare bug with Silver Scale not properly activating fixed
[*] Sharpened activates when attack damage is at least 5 
[/list]


The objective of the card changes is to give more utility to these cards so that they don’t waste space in your deck and allow them to provide powerful returns depending on how you play them. Bless and Sharpened for instance are I think both really interesting cards that can turn the tide of your battles and Incision’s extra ability makes it worthy of level III. I hope you like it and I hope it makes the game more fun to play. Thanks!

notes.title: Halloween Update 1.5.0!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/2b4de5720dfbe46081d6afedfc44116579aef7bf.png[/img]

Hello! I’ve been preparing this update for quite some time, I hope you enjoy what’s been added and changed. As usual, if you’d like to talk about the game feel free to join the [b][url=https://discord.gg/phantomrose]official discord server [/url][/b]:)

[h1]New[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/a916afb759a30bd10549d10e5e3f8ea7066151b9.png[/img]

[b]3 New Reina Skins[/b]
Three new skins have been added to the game. Witch is a halloween themed skin, Chibi and Mysterious girl’s outfit have been popular requests. The three new skins are unlocked with three new challenges that’s been added that you can also check in game![list]
[*] Witch Unlock Condition: Clear an adventure stage with 3 trial options
[*] Mysterious Unlock Condition: Clear adventure with 3 trial options
[*] Chibi Unlock Condition: Deal at least 30 damage with a single attack
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/032926fca0b822727efa181eb53a7f145724c286.gif[/img]

[b]New redraw system[/b]
Redraw system has been upgraded to give you a preview of the next 3 cards in deck that you can toggle before spending any rose. This makes redraw work more in your favor and helps you set your hand up more efficiently for the desired card synergy. Testers and members in the community who volunteered to try it out early liked it and I hope you will too. If you miss the old system and its challenges, single card redraw can be activated from the Trial Options selector for bonus XP.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/a0334d96f44cd77e4fbd21a49da56ce76621d589.png[/img]

[b]3 New Phantoms for Maid Rescue[/b]
New set of spooky Phantoms have been added for maid rescue. These Phantoms will bring new challenges different from other phantoms that you can encounter in your adventure.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/f0d4c9ec4734f37e137468b0db5434af640d6213.png[/img]

[b]Merch![/b]
If you use LINE or iMessage, you can buy these adorable Phantom Rose stickers that I drew to add flavors to your conversations! There are total of 24 stickers in a single pack and you can find them in the following stores:[list]
[*] [b]LINE:[/b] [url=https://store.line.me/stickershop/product/9264429]https://store.line.me/stickershop/product/9264429[/url]
[*] [b]iMessage:[/b] [url=https://apps.apple.com/app/phantom-rose-stickers/id1479337733]https://apps.apple.com/app/phantom-rose-stickers/id1479337733[/url]
[/list]

Also, if you prefer physical stickers or art prints, you can buy physical merchandise form my redbubble store here: [url=https://www.redbubble.com/people/makaroll/collections/1176363-phantom-rose-stickers]https://www.redbubble.com/people/makaroll/collections/1176363-phantom-rose-stickers[/url]
[/list]


[h1]Balance Changes[/h1][list]
[*] Encore card now gives 4 roses
[*] 1 less strike and shield cards for standard and casual
[*] starting rose increased to 30
[*] Heal heals 3 HP
[*] Magic Apple heals 3HP
[*] Heal at camp reduced to 25 (from 30)
[*] Elite Phantamia’s HP reduced to 30
[*] Pandora’s HP raised to 50 (from 45)
[*] Extra rose gained from defeating Phantom on stage 2, 3 reduced by 2
[*] Guardian’s DEF raised by 1
[*] Venom’s damage raised to 3 (from 2)
[*] Gold Rose’s rose amount raised to 6
[*] Card Case’s value increased to 8
[*] Crown phantom card rewards now give you less cards but give you choices between two card groups
[/list]


[h1]Bug fixes[/h1][list]
[*] Rare bug of Fate strike sometimes missing 
[*] Rare bug of charlotte’s glory animation not appearing 
[*] Bug when player has both Grim Saw and Grim Hammer  in possession and only one activates
[/list]

Thank you very much for reading and playing. I really hope you enjoy these changes!

notes.title: Trading Cards + 1.4.0 Ultra Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/d4bf9eb04d0e7fd7d4d914f44cbf80722c86c613.png[/img]

Hello! 1.4.0 Ultra Patch brings new features, new items, and interesting changes! I hope you like them! Also, feel free to join the [url=http://discord.gg/phantomrose]official discord[/url] to talk or get help about the game: [url=http://discord.gg/phantomrose]Link[/url]

[h1]1. STEAM Trading Cards[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/ba528f03d2f0a13b55c29ec26fb53be3eedb5ca8.png[/img]

Thanks to the community, Valve allowed me to make trading cards so I made them! You can collect 5 trading cards to get badges, wallpapers, and emotes just by playing the game! Happy collecting!


[h1]2. Phantom Archives[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/709b6a02be5d84314ecc1a8b463db059d8e48b6f.png[/img]

When you defeat a phantom, you'll now be able to see their information in the Phantom Archives. It'll also keep track of how many time you've defeated the Phantom.


[h1]3. Change to post-death retry[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34911158/59e411d8475b75bf039e2278f31ce5677e28e91d.png[/img]

Now you can select between a randomly selected upgrade OR cards you had from death. I hope this makes retries further interesting.


[h1]4. New Items[/h1]
6 new items have been added to the game:
[list]
[*] [b]Crowbar:[/b] Open treasure chests immediately
[*] [b]Black Axe:[/b] Skipping items after this item will raise Max HP by 2
[*] [b]Gold Rose:[/b] Gain 5 more Soul Roses after battle if remaining rose is 0
[*] [b]Dark Candle:[/b] reveal location of mystery events on map
[*] [b]Grim Hammer:[/b] Defense up when 6 cards are redrawn in a phase
[*] [b]Fancy Perfume:[/b] Add 2 "Overdrive" to deck on pick up. 
[/list]

[h1]5. New Cards[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Fever Pierce (II):[/b] Attack with ATK + sum of opponent's debuff durations
[*] [b]Overdrive (-):[/b] Activate Overdrive status immediately - Destroy cards in hand with levels and change HP to the number of cards destroyed. No enemy cards on field next phase
[/list]

[h1]5. Balance Changes & Bug fix[/h1]
[list]
[*] No more Inverse Strike
[*] Chain Strike is now level II and changed to: Attack. This & next card ignore barrier
[*] Illusion will now always inflict fear when receiving attack
[*] Fear Armor now gives 2 Thorn Armor status from 1
[*] Focus is now level III
[*] Recover is now level III
[*] Glasses will now give Attack Up 
[*] Backpack will trigger on Phase 4 from 3
[*] Small Shield will only trigger at the start of battle
[*] Elite Lurker now has Thief Stance as starting passive
[*] Venom's duration changed to 5
[*] Fixed bug with Sharp Awl triggering on bleed
[/list]

Thank you for playing! I hope you really enjoy these new changes :D

[h1]Feature:[/h1]
[list]
[*]  Added “trial options” to adventure mode for players that want to play the game with crown trial modifiers! You can select these during starting item select.
[/list]

[h1]Bug:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where skin doesn’t show unlocked in archives even though it’s unlocked in game
[*] Fixed rare issue where sometimes clicking on note doesn’t reveal note 
[*] Fixed issue where gift box wouldn’t work in crown trial. Now Ariel will happily accept your bribe
[*] Fixed issue where HP penalty occurs even after blue rose has refilled rose after phase
[/list]

[h1]Explanations for Shield:[/h1]
[b]Shield:[/b] gain barrier & return card to deck

Shield card is a barrier card without a skill level. Casual and Standard style starts with 5 of these cards in deck instead of 8 barrier cards. 

Many sent feedback in regards to barrier card and I came to agree that maintaining and refilling barrier cards currently is an unnecessary source of stress and spending of roses because it is a must-have card in most situation.
 
However, this does not mean that shield card is a permanent solution to your barrier needs. 5 is enough in the early game because the card goes back to deck but players should recognize that they need to diversify their barrier option in later phase as it will be not enough. As a result, I’m hoping to see “Shield” card as a way to smooth out the initial difficulty curve than an end-all solution to your defensive needs. 

[h1]Rose Reward Changes:[/h1]
Defeating a crown phantom is an incredible feat but rescuing those in need should also deserve an incredible reward. As such, maids will now hand over the roses she’s been hiding in her pocket so that you’ll receive greater number of roses after rescue. I personally worry whether they’ll be able to escape safely without any roses but I’m sure they would understand. 

[h1]Trial Options:[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34911158/d61f63bbac560cbb2924dd84ee934ca903ae0bbe.png[/img]
I’ve received feedback from players playing crown trial that they wanted the modifiers on adventure mode as well. So I brought them! Not all of them were applicable but players can select any number of options to make their adventure more challenging. 

Again, thank you for playing! Thank you for your feedback, and I hope this patch takes the game a step further in the right direction and make it more enjoyable to play. 

Also, join the [url=https://discord.gg/DPDpGDA]official discord[/url] if you want to chat about the game :)

notes.title: big patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34911158/aa327dfc040bcde5e8e86351e3758d7616c9a5f1.png[/img]

Hello! This is a Big Patch that brings balance changes and feature improvements. Thank you for your feedback and patience.

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] rare crown trial bug where you cannot redraw roses
[*] rare crown trial bug where debuffs disappear
[/list]

[h1]Balance updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] IMPORTANT: Balance updates only apply to new adventure runs, runs in progress are not affected 
[*] “Curse” card is gone for players and is now replaced with “Hardened”, a level II health buff card 
[*] "Chrysalis" card's skill level has changed from II to I
[*] upgrading luck at end of stage grants 10% upgrade (previously 5%)
[*] "Focus" card’s skill level has changed from I to II
[*] “Blood Lust” duration count has increased from 1 to 2
[*] risky style HP reduced from 35 to 30
[/list]

[h1]Feature updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] you can now “unlock” locked cards in hand for 2 soul roses
[*] adjustable battle speed in settings: 1x, 1.5x, 2x
[/list]

[h1]Explanations for the new card[/h1]
[b]Hardened:[/b] Gain 2 Hardened Status - absorb remaining amount of barrier at end of phase to recover HP

A source of common frustration I’d like to address first in current gameplay is the lack of options to sustain yourself in battle. Especially when you are facing unblockable damages and do not have counter cards like Cleanse. 

I believe Hardened can be a good addition in the player’s deck where it not only offers additional healing option but also makes barriers useful during fight with enemies that have unblockable attacks. It synergizes well with “Chrysalis” and now it being a lower level makes it cheaper and alleviates pressure on using barrier card alone. 

[h1]Explanation for Unlocking card in hand[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34911158/e679fa314fa7d90fe56b70d00e144887812d99a5.gif[/img]
there are moments when you see a card that you really really need… On the wrong place in the field. New feature allows you to bring the card from field, unlock it, then reposition it on the field for clutch moments when you don’t want to let your fate be decided by redraw luck.

From day 1, I’ve been observing players playing the game, and collecting feedback via various sources. I hope to make improvements one step at a time and I hope this patch alleviates some of the unfairness while keeping the game still challenging and engaging. Thanks!
